passives.name: Oath of Meteos
passives.description: (Passive Effect) When an enemy uses a non-attack skill, recovers [Buff_V_4076002_17_4] Weakness Gauge. Damage dealt increases proportional to the number of debuffs on the caster, but reduces if the target has a Barrier. Increases damage dealt to non-Water enemies and reduces damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Water enemies and increases damage taken from them.

buffs.summary: +15% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has element disadvantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has no element advantage/disadvantage
